owner.locales.title: Locale sync
owner.locales.body: Every language the live site can render, how much of each page it covers, and whether those figures come from the beta instance's working copy or from this deployment. Beta is re-read every few seconds, so a translation appears here as it is written.
owner.locales.notConfigured: The beta instance is not connected.
owner.locales.notConfiguredBody: This deployment is serving the catalogues it was built with. Set the beta origin to read new strings and languages as they are written — no restarts, no deploy.
owner.locales.liveBody: Read from {origin} {age}s ago. New and changed strings reach the browser on the next page load.
owner.locales.fallbackBody: Beta could not be read ({error}), so the site is serving this deployment's own files until it answers.
owner.locales.buildBody: These are the catalogues built into this deployment.
owner.locales.synced: The beta catalogues were read again.
owner.locales.languagesBody: A language appears as soon as one page has a file for it. A page counts as done only when that file covers every English key.
owner.locales.cataloguesBody: Percentage of each catalogue's English keys the language covers — a website page or a bot cog. A dash means no file yet, amber means a translation that started, green means complete.
owner.locales.botSectionBody: Every cog's message catalogue, counted against its own English keys. This is the wording the running bot sends in Discord.
owner.locales.siteSectionBody: The site's own page catalogues, counted against their English keys.
owner.updates.title: Zero-downtime updates
owner.updates.body: Pull the selected parts of this deployment straight from the beta instance. Each area applies the way it has to: files for the website, a reload for cogs, a module purge for utilities, a Flask rebuild for the API, and a successor process for the bot core. Nothing restarts unless its own area changed.
owner.updates.areasBody: Switch on the areas to pull from beta. Areas without changes are up to date and stay off.
owner.updates.notConfigured: The update feed is not configured.
owner.updates.notConfiguredBody: Set the beta origin and the shared update token to stage files from beta. Without both, this page can only report what is already deployed.
owner.updates.noTokenBody: BETA_UPDATE_TOKEN must match on beta and here before beta will serve its files.
owner.updates.refreshed: Feed refreshed · {count} files waiting from beta.
owner.updates.botWarning: The bot core update starts a successor process on this deployment's own listening socket. It connects the gateway with the new code, this process lets go and exits, and the successor answers commands once it has the session. Expect a second or two where commands are not answered; the site keeps serving throughout.
owner.updates.lastBody: Run {id}. Every replaced file is kept under data/updates/backups.
owner.area.website: Replaces the built site. Flask serves the folder from disk, so the next request is the new site with nothing restarted.
owner.area.cogs: Drops the cached cog modules and reloads only the changed extensions, so the new file is what imports.
owner.area.utils: Purges the changed utility modules, reloads the extensions that import them, and rebuilds the dashboard.
owner.area.webapp: Re-imports the API and swaps the new Flask app into the running server. The listening socket never closes.
owner.area.bot: Starts a successor process on the inherited socket, moves the gateway to it, then retires this one.
